_template_metadata.description: UDF benchmark config master template. Extra metadata keys are ignored by the current loader. Copy this file and edit the actual config sections below.

required_when.input.neural_udf_model_path: required when input.mode = neural_udf and batch.enabled = false
required_when.batch.neural_udf_model_directory: required when input.mode = neural_udf and batch.enabled = true

constraints.input.geometry_type=point_cloud: only .ply is accepted for input_path / batch.input_extension
constraints.auto_split.error_threshold: must be > 0 when auto_split.enabled = true and auto_split.mode = error_threshold
constraints.auto_split.max_nb_spheres: must be > 0 when auto_split.enabled = true and auto_split.mode = max_nb_spheres

notes: Single-run mode: set batch.enabled = false, then fill input.geometry_type plus input.input_path (or legacy input.surface_path for mesh) and output.skeleton_ply.
Batch mode: set batch.enabled = true, then fill batch.input_directory and batch.output_directory. Per-case output paths are generated automatically.
When input.geometry_type = point_cloud, the benchmark point loader only accepts .ply and will reject .obj/.off/.stl with a config error before loading.
When input.geometry_type = mesh, benchmark loading uses the surface loader and accepts .obj, .ply, .off, .stl.
Set output.save_face_components = true to export skeleton face_component colors as a face color attribute in the output ply.
Set batch.resume_from_existing = true to skip cases whose skeleton output already exists; if timing_directory is set, the timing json must also exist for the case to be treated as completed.
All input modes now use the same batched Bridson sampler; configure it with sampling.bridson.*.
sampling.bridson.candidate_mode accepts 3d_shell and 2d_plane; 2d_tangent_ring is kept as a backward-compatible alias.
Bridson seed warmup uses sampling.ray_sampler_batch_size for sampling.ray_sampler_batch_size x sampling.bridson.warmup_iterations rays before active-list growth starts.
sampling.bridson.alpha_projection_max_iterations controls how many alpha-projection refinement iterations each Bridson candidate may use before acceptance checks.
input.ma_flip_prune_alpha_factor scales the MF MAFlipPrune score threshold from alpha to alpha * factor while keeping the positive-SDF reject rule unchanged.
When postprocess.residual_prune is true, completion residual prune now deletes all sheets with face_count <= 2.
